votes.motion: Approve the Turkey Hill Lions Club Fall Roadblock on November 10, 2012, 8AM-2PM, in the Town Center and at Electric Ave and Whalom Rd.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to approve the turkey hill lions club fall roadblock on november 10, 2012 between the hours of 8am-2pm.

votes.motion: Approve the Salvation Army request to hold a Voluntary Toll Booth on 12/01/12 at the Town Center and the intersection of Electric Ave and Whalom Rd.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to approve the salvation army request to hold a voluntary toll booth on 12/01/12 at the town center and the intersection of electric ave and whalom rd.

votes.motion: Authorize emergency spending under MGL Chapter 44, Section 31 for the October 31, 2011 storm event.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved that the bos authorize emergency spending under mgl chapter 44, section 31 for the october 31, 2011 storm event.

votes.motion: Go into Executive Session (to discuss strategy on collective bargaining or litigation, not returning to open session).
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to go into executive session. ms. bertram seconded. the board voted unanimously to adjourn regular session at 8:13pm.

decisions.decision: Continue the Power Purchase Agreement and PILOT Agreement for Solar item to 11/13/12 at 6PM; all board members confirmed they will attend.
decisions.quote: ms. speidel requested confirmation from the three board members present this evening that they will be available on 11/13/12 at 6pm for this discussion.

decisions.decision: The BOS gives full support to the Eagle Heights senior housing project in the center of town.
decisions.quote: a large contingency of lunenburg senior citizens have voiced their desire to have this project built in the center of town, to which the bos gives their full support.

decisions.decision: The BOS agreed it could provide the same concessions Townsend gave the Eagle Heights project (land donation, fee waivers, extension of the Land Disposition Agreement).
decisions.quote: agreed that they could provide the same concessions that townsend did which are as follows:

decisions.decision: Ms. Speidel will update all Eagle Heights information for a future BOS meeting and will contact the Sewer and Water Departments to begin discussions on fee waivers.
decisions.quote: ms. speidel will update all information pertaining to the eagle heights project to be discussed again at a future bos

decisions.decision: Board members agreed to support the holiday decorating donation solicitation by Dave MacDonald and Mike Nault, provided they work with the DPW, Public Safety, and the neighbors.
decisions.quote: board members were in agreement that they support this effort as long as they work in conjunction with the dpw, public safety, and with the neighbors.

decisions.decision: Ms. Speidel requested that the Regional E911 report become a monthly agenda item at BOS meetings.
decisions.quote: ms. speidel would like this to become a monthly agenda item at the bos meetings.

decisions.decision: Tax title accounts to be discussed on a yearly basis; the top 26 properties on the list will be dealt with first.
decisions.quote: all agreed this should be discussed on a yearly basis

decisions.decision: Ms. Speidel will review the Building Inspector's report on abandoned properties and share it with the BOS.
decisions.quote: ms. speidel replied that the building inspector had given her a report on inspections that he had done on abandoned properties which she will review and share with the bos.

decisions.decision: The BOS will consider whether to organize a Budget Working Committee / Service Levels Group with the Finance Committee and discuss it at a later date.
decisions.quote: mr. matthews would like the bos to think about this process and discuss it again at a later date.
